// Derives xlsx-widthless-cols.xlsx from the G0 kitchen-sink: the same package
// with a style-only <col> (no width attribute) on columns B:C of sheet Data.
// Usage: node make-widthless-cols.cjs <jszip dir> <kitchen-sink.xlsx> <out dir>
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const [jszipDir, source, outDir] = process.argv.slice(2);
const JSZip = require(jszipDir);

(async () => {
  const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(fs.readFileSync(source));
  const part = "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml";
  const xml = await zip.file(part).async("string");
  if (xml.includes("<cols")) throw new Error("source already has <cols>");
  zip.file(part, xml.replace("<sheetData>", '<cols><col min="2" max="3" style="0"/></cols><sheetData>'));
  const bytes = await zip.generateAsync({ type: "nodebuffer", compression: "DEFLATE" });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, "xlsx-widthless-cols.xlsx"), bytes);
})();
